items.title: FPGA bitstream documentation
items.goal: Complete, machine-readable bitstream databases for every commercial off-the-shelf FPGA family

items.title: Open "almost manufacturable" PDKs
items.goal: Realistic open PDKs at 55/45nm, 28/22nm and pre-EUV FinFET (16/12nm class), with consistency audits and generated docs

items.title: Design rule checking (DRC)
items.goal: Full-chip DRC in under one hour on a cluster, with exhaustive per-rule test suites and rules that explain themselves

items.title: Open TCAD stack
items.goal: Process and device simulation that reproduces an existing open PDK from its process description

items.title: Adder and multiplier exploration
items.goal: Generate and characterise many arithmetic architectures per node so open synthesis picks the best one

items.title: Reproducible and signed toolchain
items.goal: Bit-identical tool builds and outputs, with every tool, PDK and artefact signed and logged

items.title: Composable and distributed simulation
items.goal: Swap Renode, Verilator or FPGA emulation per SoC block, and scale the model across a cluster

items.title: Standard cell generation
items.goal: Generate, characterise and verify complete cell libraries for any PDK, voltage and track height

items.title: Toolchain verification
items.goal: Per-stage checks that each open FPGA and ASIC tool's output is correct, so failures point at the tool that caused them

items.title: Accelerator interface and harness (FPGA and ASIC)
items.goal: One accelerator interface with two focuses: a LiteX FPGA flavour and a Sea2sky-style ASIC harness, sharing host software

items.title: FPGA benchmarking
items.goal: Continuous open-versus-vendor FPGA toolchain benchmark on real boards, with seed statistics

items.title: ASIC benchmarking
items.goal: Re-runnable benchmark of open ASIC flows on every open shuttle design, tracked over time

items.title: FPGA Interchange and open place and route
items.goal: Revive FPGA Interchange and make VPR and nextpnr competitive with vendor tools

items.title: Incremental toolchains
items.goal: FPGA and ASIC flows where a small change costs a small rebuild, identical to a full one

items.title: Fully open FPGA and eFPGA
items.goal: An open FPGA and eFPGA architecture, hardened with open tools, competitive with commercial parts

items.title: Open high-speed connectivity IP
items.goal: Open PCIe, USB 3, Ethernet and DDR controllers and PHYs that work on FPGAs and in ASICs

items.title: Open MPW tapeout programs
items.goal: Recurring open shuttles whose designs and silicon results build a library of proven IP and benchmarks

items.title: Replicating classic ASIC and FPGA papers
items.goal: Reproduce key past papers and test whether their conclusions hold with AI and fast compute

items.title: Libraries for every EDA file format
items.goal: Well-tested readers and writers for every open and proprietary EDA format, shared by all tools

items.title: Partial hardening: ASIC core plus eFPGA and software
items.goal: Harden only the critical high-performance core as ASIC; put the rest in eFPGA and software on CPUs

groups.name: PDKs and physical design
groups.note: shadow-pdks needs rule decks (drc-forge), physics-based models (tcad-twin) and cell libraries (cell-foundry) to be usable, and shuttles (shuttle-program) to prove them in silicon.

groups.name: FPGA ecosystem
groups.note: bitstream-atlas feeds open-pnr; open-fabric skips the reverse engineering entirely; fpga-scoreboard scores all of it.

groups.name: Toolchain quality and speed
groups.note: signed-builds makes flow-proofs and instant-rebuild checkable; format-kit gives every tool correct readers and writers; asic-scoreboard and paper-replay measure the result.

groups.name: Design, IP and system integration
groups.note: arithmetic-zoo and open-links are building blocks; accel-harness and sim-mosaic connect them to hosts and to each other; hard-core combines a hard block, open-fabric eFPGA and CPUs in one chip.
